About Us

Where Effort Turns Into Results

F5 Fitness Studio Unisex A/C is an air-conditioned gym and physical fitness center on Muthirapalayam Road, Pondicherry. Train with free weights, strength machines, battle ropes and cardio, with programs for weight loss, weight gain and strength.

  • Air-conditioned unisex studio
  • Separate men's & women's packages
  • Diet & nutrition guidance
  • Strength, battle rope and cardio training
What We Offer

Our Programs

Weight Loss Program

Fat-burning workouts, battle ropes and cardio with a plan built around your body.

Weight Gain Program

Progressive overload and nutrition guidance to build healthy mass.

Cardio Workout

Boost stamina and heart health with treadmills, ropes and conditioning.

Diet & Nutrition

Simple diet guidance to fuel your training and speed up results.
